title: Who am I
lyrics_original: Who am I, that the lord of all the earth
Would care to know my name
Would care to feel my hurt?
Who am I, that the bright and morning star
Would choose to light the way
For my ever wandering heart?
Not because of who I am
But because of what you've done

But because of who you are
I am a flower quickly fading
Here today and gone tomorrow
A wave tossed in the ocean
A vapor in the wind
Still you hear me when I'm calling
Lord, you catch me when I'm falling
And you've told me who I am
I am yours

bible_verses.telugu: నీవు మనుష్యుని జ్ఞాపకము చేసికొనుటకు వాడేపాటి వాడు?నీవు నరపుత్రుని దర్శించుటకు వాడేపాటివాడు?
bible_verses.english: what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?

bible_verses.telugu: మీరు విశ్వాసముద్వారా కృపచేతనే రక్షింపబడియున్నారు; ఇది మీవలన కలిగినది కాదు, దేవుని వరమే. అది క్రియలవలన కలిగినదికాదు గనుక ఎవడును అతిశయపడ వీలులేదు.
bible_verses.english: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.

bible_verses.telugu: మన క్రియలనుబట్టి కాక తన స్వకీయ సంకల్పమును బట్టియు, అనాదికాలముననే క్రీస్తుయేసునందు మనకు అనుగ్రహింపబడినదియు,
bible_verses.english: He has saved us and called us to a holy life—not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, I am humbled when I consider how You know my name and care for my deepest pain. Thank You that Your love for me does not depend on my performance, but entirely on Your unconditional grace. Forgive me for trying to earn Your favor or wandering from Your path. Help me rest today in the truth of who You are and what You have done for me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, I am humbled when I consider how You know my name and care for my deepest pain. Thank You that Your love for me does not depend on my performance, but entirely on Your unconditional grace. Forgive me for trying to earn Your favor or wandering from Your path. Help me rest today in the truth of who You are and what You have done for me. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Have you ever wondered why the Creator of the universe cares so deeply for your wandering heart? It is easy to feel small and undeserving, yet God's love is never based on our achievements or perfection. Instead, His grace flows entirely from His unwavering character and what Jesus has accomplished on the cross. Today, you are invited to step out of the pressure to perform and simply rest in the overwhelming wonder of being deeply known and loved by Him.
